name: Sunlaws Development Company Limited
ownership_summary: Active private limited company incorporated 27 October 1989, registered at Roxburghe Estates Office, Kelso TD5 7SF. SIC codes 56101 (licensed restaurants) and 68209 (letting/operating own or leased real estate) — a long-standing estate vehicle, not a data-centre SPV. Until 1 April 2024 controlled by the 'Second Discretionary Trust' (75%+ of shares); since then four individual PSCs each recorded with 'significant influence or control': Andrew William Michael Christie-Miller, Louisa Ann Church, Dermot Julian Jenkinson and Lord Andrew Victor Hope. Press describes it as 'made up of Roxburghe Estates and the landowner' / the estate's development arm.
notes: Also the named applicant for EIA screening 25/01835/SCR and the PAN.

name: Roxburghe Estates
ownership_summary: Estate of the Duke of Roxburghe (Innes-Ker family), managed from the Roxburghe Estates Office, Kelso. The Southside site at Clawbare Cottage is on Roxburghe Estate land; Sunlaws Development Company Ltd is described as the estate's development arm. Managing Director Jaap Röell has fronted the consultation; the Duke of Roxburghe attended the Westruther consultation event.
notes: Roxburghe Estates itself is not a single registered company; the precise legal owner of the site (trust or estate entity) has not been verified against Registers of Scotland.

name: Save the Lammermuirs – Stop the Data Centre
notes: Community campaign group launched at the site in late May/early June 2026; contact savethelammermuirs@gmail.com; associated online petition reported at over 6,000 signatures by mid-June 2026.

name: SP Energy Networks / SP Transmission (inferred network operator)
notes: The Scottish Borders lies in the SP Energy Networks distribution and SP Transmission areas, and the developer cites the Fallago Rig substation; however no source names the network operator or evidences a connection application. Recorded as inferred context only.
